liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Let It Grow** (3 reviews): Hornsby's solo jam after Let It Grow led into Box of Rain, and the reviewer replayed it constantly; Let It Grow is really great; the only flaw is Row Jimmy [20][22][24]
- **Dark Star** (2 reviews, 1 other source): Dark Star is the show's standout: high-energy, freaky, with spectacular drums, and Jerry pulls it together into Throwing Stones and NFA; Dark Star makes up for the weaker moments [5][21][22]
- **Jack Straw** (1 review): Jack Straw opener rocks hard, followed by a sweet Half-Step [23]
- **Walkin' Blues** (1 review): Jerry's solo in Walkin' Blues is tight [20]
- **Eyes Of The World** (1 review): Second set opens strongly with a sweet Eyes of the World [23]

## The recordings

- **gd1990-10-20.mtx.hansokolow.98728.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 157 min; rated 4.75/5 by 4 [1]
- **gd1990-10-20.nak300.houck-wright.gmb.90641.sbeok.flac16**: audience recording; 21 songs; 156 min [2]
- **gd1990-10-20.167632.nak700.blend.vita.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 21 songs; 157 min [3]
- **gd1990-10-20.138476.BK4011.fob.Teitelbaum.Ammons.Noel.t-flac16**: source not stated; 22 songs; 160 min [5]. Said about its sound: A mic bump in the first track was softened [5]
- **gd90-10-20.dsbd-matrix.dieter.12931.sbefail.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 153 min; rated 4.08/5 by 25 [16]. Said about its sound: Digital soundboard matrix with a full, nice sound [20]

## Around the show

- The audience going wild is part of the experience, even on the soundboard [21]
- Small venue, about 4000 max, a conference center with airplane-style fold-down shelves on each seat [24]
- Reviewer found Jerry's vocal flubs in the first set distracting [24]
- Phil and Bruce played excellently, while Jerry was less impressive [28]
- Strangers hugged afterward with tears streaming down their faces [30]
- Attendee found the previous night in the same venue lackluster, but this night was magical from the first note [30]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1990-10-20.mtx.hansokolow.98728.flac16**: transferred by hansokolow; source: matrix of SBD: shnid=12931 and DAUD: shnid=90641 using ProTools [1]. Also: Matrix by hansokolow in ProTools; the show was broadcast on German FM radio, and this is not the old FM bootleg; Audience master: Nakamichi 300 cardioids to Marantz PMD-430 to Sony Walkman Pro D-6 with Dolby B; tapers Alf Houck and Robert Wright; Transferred and mastered by Bill Koucky on March 6, 2008, via Nakamichi DR-1 and WaveLab at 24/96 [1]
- **gd1990-10-20.nak300.houck-wright.gmb.90641.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Alf Houck and Robert Wright; transferred by Bill Koucky; source: Audience Master Cassette Nakamichi 300's Cardioids > Marantz [2]. Also: Nakamichi 300 Houck-Wright audience source; soundboard 12931 patches tape flips before Jack-A-Roe and during Drums [2]
- **gd1990-10-20.167632.nak700.blend.vita.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Jim Vita; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Jim Vita's Master Audience Cassettes; Nakamichi 700 mics x3 > unknown mixer > Sony D5M (Maxell XLII-S) [3]. Also: A Schoeps CMC5 MK21 source supplies a 13-second patch in Space [3]
- **gd1990-10-20.138476.BK4011.fob.Teitelbaum.Ammons.Noel.t-flac16**: taped by Mark Teitelbaum; transferred by John Ammons and Joe Noel; source: flac16/48kHz ; Mark Teitelbaum Recording: B&K 4011 (ORTF) > Neumann power supply > Panasonic SV255; FOB w/ stand; John Ammons [5]
- **gd90-10-20.dsbd-matrix.dieter.12931.sbefail.shnf**: source: DSBD: Healy mix>MD>D>CD [16]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Internationales Congress Centrum - October 20, 1990](https://www.dead.net/show/october-20-1990) [33]
- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Internationales Congress Centrum - October 20, 1990](https://www.dead.net/show/october-20-1990) [34]
- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1990-10-20 Grateful Dead Backstage Pass - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/1990-10-20-grateful-dead-backstage-pass/) [35]
